verdicts.reason: Both are the same straight re-centre of the original onto a square, not a real rearrangement. In both, the missing-asset placeholder box covers the end of the legal line ('full details'), and a decorative dot sits on 'bottled' in the body copy. The 'AWARD WINNING 2026' badge has lost its pill, so it no longer matches the other two badges. The legal text is too small to read, and the bottle is small for the canvas. A wins only slightly: its SOLSTICE logo is scaled up in proportion with the canvas, while B's logo stays at the original pixel size and looks shrunken.
